name: AI Toolbox (test fixture)
description: Test-only ai-tool module used to exercise module tools in the assistant.

tools.name: Echo text
tools.description: Echo the given text back; verifies the module RPC path end to end.

tools.name: Leaky payload
tools.description: Returns payloads that include fields the assistant must never forward.

tools.name: Failing tool
tools.description: Always fails with an internal error message.

tools.name: Slow tool
tools.description: Sleeps past the call timeout so the kernel reports MODULE_TIMEOUT.
